errors.evidence: After rising at captured_distance=2 (to approx. 79.2%), the F1 line drops to approx. 77.9% at x=3 and 76.0% at x=4. It does not drop to 77% in this segment; the value at x=3 is closer to 78%.

The description claims the F1 line stabilizes, but it actually fluctuates significantly after x=5. It drops from a peak of ~80% to a minimum of ~75% at x=7, and then rises again to ~75.7% at x=8. This is not stabilization.
The value for the blue line (Acc) at captured_distance=3 is approximately 74.0%, not 73.5%. The data point is clearly shown on or very close to the y=74 grid line.
The description fails to mention the markers used for each line: circles for F1 and triangles for Acc.
